source_evidence.qualification_scope: Five source-qualified CVPR2026 main papers; source qualification is not runtime/capacity/legal redistribution approval.

paper.title: Edge-RecViT: Efficient Vision Transformer via Semantic-Refined Dynamic Recursion

repository.official_link_evidence: Primary CVF/complete PDF and author repository qualification recorded in candidate_backbones.json; reused fixed source evidence, not a new author inertial implementation.

source_recheck.method: Each actual core raw file SHA/byte count verified and AST parsed, no upstream module imported. Fixed root LICENSE raw bytes fetched/hash matched and saved unmodified using apply_patch. Prior complete primary PDF qualification reused from source evidence; no datasets/weights fetched.

adaptation.selected_core: Released-code three-layer token-depth router plus distinct head/tail and one truly reused middle transformer; not an unshared ordinary ViT.
adaptation.draft_recipe_status: Explicit compact width/depth/patch/operator/initialization hypotheses; not original full visual-model profile, measured capacity, accuracy, latency or final-initialization parity.
adaptation.initialization: Router linear weights use source normal std0.02; temporal CLS/position truncated-normal std0.02. Remaining compact temporal transformer/stem/head defaults are an adapter recipe, not source full-model pretrained/final-init parity.
adaptation.readout: Final LayerNorm, CLS token (index0), one Linear(d_model,3) XYZ head. CLS is NOT unified temporal GAP.
keep: One temporal token stream including a learned CLS token and learned within-window positions
Released three-linear router: D->2D GELU->2D ReLU->depth, no linear biases
Training clamped-uniform Gumbel-Softmax at temperature1 with straight-through hard depth; eval argmax
CLS forced to full depth, token survival gates formed from selected depth
Independent first/head and last/tail transformer units, a single middle unit called repeatedly with shared parameters
Released masked-residual writes at each step, pre-LN attention/MLP and final LayerNorm
replace: RGB image patches/2D positions -> Conv1d(6,32,p4,stride4) temporal patches and learned 1D position table
Source image classification head -> one learned CLS-to-XYZ velocity head and plain supervised MSE
Full visual size/recursion profile -> explicit compact D32/H4/depth4/MLP2 draft
omitted: Classification confidence/CE and source routing regularizers or balancing losses
Pretrained DeiT/downloads, DoRA/warmup and image-only training wrappers
Paper two-layer EARR ranker when it differs from released code
paper_code_adapter_differences: Paper EARR is two-layer; fixed released router is three-linear GELU/ReLU.
Released main forward uses Gumbel-Softmax straight-through; router helper also contains a multinomial training branch, not used here.
Released balancing regularizer is variance hinge rather than paper expected/realized DU; all these losses are omitted in the selected MSE architecture identity.
Every recursive step executes a dense transformer even for halted token writes. Parameter tying and masking are not measured sparse compute savings.
CLS readout differs from GAP candidates and must be reported as a readout confound/matched-pooling ablation rather than described as a shared GAP head.
adaptation.objective: Shared plain supervised MSE over actual learned XYZ whole-window average velocity only; set_loss rejects non-MSE or kwargs. No source-task/SSL/teacher losses mixed into this identity.
adaptation.input_permissions: Same admitted reference_oracle six-axis task view as controls; no image/text/skeleton/geography/initial velocity/extra sensor/targets in forward/per-test fitting.
adaptation.temporal_scope: window_noncausal; only admitted T200 samples, no outside-window context or persistent fast weights/hidden state/maps.
risks: Temporal event depth ranking and router collapse remain unverified from scratch.
True middle weight tying does not establish FLOPs/latency savings in dense execution.
Hard eval routing versus training STE and CLS/GAP differences need scientific and matched-control tests.

scientific_contract.output: vel:B,3 real supervised XYZ average velocity in m/s; no zero-padded Z
scientific_contract.xy_semantics: XY is the slice of the same XYZ prediction, no second XY model/head
scientific_contract.task_head: Final LayerNorm, CLS token (index0), one Linear(d_model,3) XYZ head. CLS is NOT unified temporal GAP.
scientific_contract.optional_ssl_or_auxiliary_recipe: Not selected; any future source-specific loss requires separately named preregistered identity and budget.
